picture-pairs.name: Izibini zemifanekiso
picture-pairs.description: Umdlalo wasimahla nozolileyo wokungqamanisa owenzelwe abantu abaphila nedementia. Imifanekiso emikhulu ihlala ibonakala, akukho xesha libalwayo okanye amanqaku, kwaye ukhetha amakhadi aphakathi ko-4 no-12.
picture-pairs.short: Fumana imifanekiso emibini efanayo. Imifanekiso ingahlala ibonakala.
picture-pairs.players: Umntu o-1 okanye aba-2, behleli kunye
picture-pairs.intro: Cofa umfanekiso, uze ucofe lowo ufana nawo. Imifanekiso ihlala ibonakala ngokwesiqhelo, ukuze kungabikho mfuneko yakukhumbula nto. Xa imifanekiso emibini ihambelana, ifumana umgca wegolide ojikelezileyo kunye nophawu lokukhetha.
howTo: Khetha inani lamakhadi ofuna ukuwasebenzisa. Amakhadi amane yindawo ezolileyo yokuqalisa.
Cofa nawuphi na umfanekiso. Uza kuba nomgca wegolide ojikelezileyo.
Cofa umfanekiso okhangeleka ufana nawo. Ezo zibini zihlala kunye zinophawu lokukhetha.
Ukuba le mifanekiso mibini yahlukile, akukho nto imbi yenzekayo. Cofa kwakhona nanini na xa ulungile.
Vula "Imifanekiso efihliweyo" kuphela ukuba nobabini niyayithanda indlela yakudala ejonge phantsi.
tips: Wabizeni amagama emifanekiso ngelizwi elivakalayo nincokole ngayo: "Ikomityi yeti ebomvu. Ingaba uyagalela ubisi etini yakho?"
Vumela umntu omnonophelayo acofe, nokuba kuthatha ixesha. Yala ngomnwe kunokuba umcofele.
Hlalani kumakhadi amane logama kusenetofontofo. Amakhadi angakumbi lukhetho lwakho, akuyomfuneko ukufikelela kwelinye inqanaba.
Gqibezelani ngelixa kusamnandi. Umdlalo omnye ngumsebenzi opheleleyo.

faq.q: Ingaba likhona ixesha elibaliweyo okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo okanye ukoyiswa. Ungayeka nanini na, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi yindlela entle kakhulu yokugqiba.

Ukugcina imifanekiso ibonakala kwenza umdlalo ube ngowokujonga nokungqamanisa kunokuba ngowokukhumbula. Abantu abaninzi bafumanisa oku kuzolisa ngakumbi. Ungatshintshela kwimifanekiso efihliweyo ngokucofa kanye ukuba uyafuna.

faq.q: Ingaba usimahla, kwaye ingaba kufuneka ndibhalise?
faq.a: Ewe, usimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa okanye kukhuphela. Usebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, kwithebhulethi okanye kwikhompyutha.
Ewe. Zama Izibini zeefoto, ezikuvumela ukuba ukhethe iifoto kwisixhobo sakho. Iifoto zihlala kwisikhangeli sakho kwaye azilayishwa kwenye indawo.

find-the-same.name: Fumana efanayo
find-the-same.seoTitle: Fumana Umfanekiso Ofanayo: Umdlalo Olula weDementia
find-the-same.description: Umfanekiso omnye ngasentla, emibini ukuya kwemine ngezantsi. Cofa lowo ufana nawo. Umdlalo wemifanekiso ozolileyo nosimahla owenzelwe abantu abaphila nedementia, ongenalo ixesha elibalwayo.
find-the-same.short: Jonga umfanekiso ongasentla uze ucofe lowo ufana nawo ngezantsi.
find-the-same.intro: Umfanekiso omnye umi phezulu kwesikrini. Ngezantsi kwawo kukho imifanekiso emibini, emithathu okanye emine. Cofa lowo ufana nawo. Lukhetho olunye olulula ngexesha ngalinye, olunethuba elaneleyo lokuncokola.
howTo: Khetha imifanekiso emibini, emithathu okanye emine onokukhetha kuyo. Emibini yeyona ilula.
Jongani umfanekiso ongasentla kunye.
Cofa umfanekiso ofanayo ngezantsi. Uphawulwa ngokukhetha kunye namazwi ambalwa obuhlobo.
Ukuba kucofwe umfanekiso owahlukileyo, umdlalo ubiza igama lawo nje uze ulinde. Thatha ixesha lakho.
Cofa "Umfanekiso olandelayo" xa ulungele omnye.
tips: Ncokolani ngomfanekiso ngamnye ngaphambi kokukhetha: imibala, iimilo, nendawo eninokumbona kuyo.
Ukhetho olubini alukho "lula kakhulu". Injongo ngumzuzu omnandi, hayi umngeni.
Ukuba ukucofa kunzima, loo mntu unokwalatha ngomnwe uze umcofele.

faq.q: Ingaba likhona ixesha elibaliweyo okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo okanye ukoyiswa. Ungayeka nanini na, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi yindlela entle kakhulu yokugqiba.

faq.q: Kwenzeka ntoni ukuba kucofwe umfanekiso ongeyiyo?
faq.a: Akukho nto ingathandekiyo eyenzekayo. Akukho sithonga sokukhalisa, mnqamlezo ubomvu okanye kungcangcazela. Umdlalo ubiza igama lomfanekiso ocofiweyo uze ulinde ukucofa okulandelayo.

faq.q: Ingaba usimahla, kwaye ingaba kufuneka ndibhalise?
faq.a: Ewe, usimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa okanye kukhuphela. Usebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, kwithebhulethi okanye kwikhompyutha.

shadow-match.name: Ngqamanisa isithunzi
shadow-match.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wokungqamanisa Isithunzi weDementia: Wasimahla kwi-Intanethi
shadow-match.description: Isithunzi esimnyama ngasentla, imifanekiso emibini ukuya kwemine ngezantsi. Cofa umfanekiso owenza eso sithunzi. Umdlalo wasimahla nozolileyo wokungqamanisa izithunzi we-dementia, ongenalo ixesha elibalwayo.
shadow-match.short: Jonga isithunzi uze ucofe umfanekiso owenza eso sithunzi.
shadow-match.intro: Ukungqamanisa izithunzi ngumsebenzi owaziwayo kumaphepha ashicilelweyo, apha ungowemifanekiso emikhulu kwaye akukho nto yakushicilelwa. Isithunzi esithambileyo sihlala phezulu kwesikrini kwaye imifanekiso emibini, emithathu okanye emine ilindele ngezantsi. Cofa lowo wenza eso sithunzi. Iimilo ezifana nebhayisekile, isambrela okanye ikomityi yeti kulula ukuthetha ngazo nazo.
howTo: Khetha imifanekiso emibini, emithathu okanye emine onokukhetha kuyo. Emibini yeyona ilula.
Jonganani nesithunzi kunye. Yimilo enjani? Inde okanye irhangqiwe?
Cofa umfanekiso owenza eso sithunzi. Igama lawo livela phantsi kweso sithunzi.
Ukuba kucofwe umfanekiso owahlukileyo, umdlalo ubiza igama lawo nje uze ulinde. Thatha ixesha lakho.
Cofa "Isithunzi esilandelayo" xa ulungele esinye.
tips: Landa umgca wesithunzi ngomnwe uze uthethe ngemilo yaso.
Ukuba izithunzi zivakala zinzima namhlanje, tshintshela ku-Fumana efanayo, apho imifanekiso ifana khona.
Ncokolani ngomfanekiso wakuba ufunyenwe: "Sasinesambrela esinjalo."

faq.q: Ingaba likhona ixesha elibaliweyo okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo okanye ukoyiswa. Ungayeka nanini na, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi yindlela entle kakhulu yokugqiba.

faq.q: Ngaba ukutshatisa izithunzi kulungile kubantu abaphila nedementia?
faq.a: Inokuba ngumsebenzi owonwabisayo nolula kwabanye abantu, ingakumbi kumanqanaba okuqala. Iimilo kulula ukuzibona kunezwi. Yenzelwe ukonwaba nokuncokola, ayilulo uvavanyo, kwaye ayinyangi okanye icothise idementia. Ukuba ibangela unxunguphalo, zama Fumana efanayo okanye niphonononge nje imifanekiso kunye.

faq.q: Kwenzeka ntoni xa kucofwe umfanekiso ongeyiyo?
faq.a: Akukho nto ingathandekiyo eyenzekayo. Akukho sithonga, mnqamlezo ubomvu okanye ukungcangcazela. Umdlalo ubiza igama lomfanekiso ocofiweyo uze ulinde ukucofa okulandelayo.
Ewe, usimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa okanye kukhuphela. Usebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha.

sort-together.name: Hlela kunye
sort-together.description: Cofa umfanekiso, uze ucofe ibhaskithi ekufuneka uye kuyo: ekhitshini okanye egadini, iziqhamo okanye izilwanyana. Umsebenzi wokuhlela ozolileyo nosimahla wabantu abaphila nedementia.
sort-together.short: Beka umfanekiso ngamnye kwibhaskithi yawo: ekhitshini okanye egadini, nezinye.
sort-together.intro: Ukuhlela ngumsebenzi wemihla ngemihla oqhelekileyo nonelisayo, njengokubeka igrosari endaweni yayo okanye ukutshatisa iikawusi. Cofa umfanekiso, uze ucofe ibhaskithi ekufuneka uye kuyo. Akukho kungxama kwaye akukho mpazamo.
howTo: Khetha umxholo: ikhitshi negadi, iziqhamo nezilwanyana, okanye ikhaya nohambo.
Cofa umfanekiso. Ufumana umgca wegolide ojikelezileyo.
Cofa ibhaskithi ekufuneka uye kuyo. Umfanekiso uyangena kuloo bhaskithi.
Ukuba ufanele ukuya kwenye ibhaskithi, umdlalo utsho ngobubele uze ulinde.
Xa yonke imifanekiso ihleliwe, jonganani neebhaskithi kunye.
tips: Kubomi bokwenyani amaxesha amaninzi akukho mpendulo iphosakeleyo. Ukuba umntu uthi ikani yokunkcenkceshela yeyasekhitshini, buza isizathu. Ungafumana ibali elimnandi.
Sebenzisa imifanekiso ukuqalisa incoko: "Yintoni owawuyityala egadini yakho?"
Ukuhlela izinto zokwenyani, njengamacephe neefolokhwe okanye amaqhosha ngokwemibala, lulandelelwano oluhle kakhulu ngaphandle kwesikrini.

faq.q: Ngaba kukhona ixesha elibalwayo okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo okanye ukoyisakala. Unokuyeka nanini na, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi yindlela entle kakhulu yokugqiba.
Abantu abaninzi bayakuthanda ukuhlela kuba kuvakala kungumsebenzi oluncedo noqhelekileyo. Kukulula nokuncokola ngemifanekiso ngeli xesha niqhubeka.
Ewe, usimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa okanye kukhuphela. Usebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha.

picture-puzzle.name: Iphazili yemifanekiso
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Iphazili Elula yeJigsaw yeDementia: Amaqhekeza ama-4 okanye ali-9
picture-puzzle.description: Ijigsaw elula ekwi-intanethi yabantu abaphila nedementia: amaqhekeza amakhulu ama-4 okanye ali-9, wonke umfanekiso uhlala ubonakala, kwaye ucofa amaqhekeza amabini ukuwatshintshiselana.
picture-puzzle.short: Cofa amaqhekeza amabini ukuwatshintshiselana ade umfanekiso uphelele.
picture-puzzle.intro: Umfanekiso owamkelekileyo usikwe waba ngamaqhekeza amakhulu amane okanye alithoba aza axutywa. Wonke umfanekiso uhlala ubonakala njengesikhokelo. Cofa iqhekeza elinye, uze ucofe elinye, aze atshintshisane ngeendawo. Akukho kurhuqa kufunekayo.
howTo: Khetha umfanekiso kunye namaqhekeza ama-4 okanye ali-9. Amaqhekeza amane sisiqalo esilula nesithambileyo.
Jonga wonke umfanekiso ngasentla.
Cofa iqhekeza, uze ucofe indawo ekufuneka liye kuyo. La maqhekeza mabini ayatshintshisana.
Amaqhekeza asendaweni efanelekileyo afumana uphawu oluncinci lokuchanisa.
Xa umfanekiso uphelele, wonwabeleni kunye, nize nikhethe omnye.
tips: Ukucofa amaqhekeza amabini ukuwatshintshiselana kulula kakhulu kukurhuqa kwabantu abaninzi.
Thethani ngomfanekiso njengoko udibana: "Nalu uphahla olubomvu."
Ijigsaw yokwenyani yomthi enamalungu amakhulu ali-12 ukuya kwangama-24 ngumsebenzi omhle kakhulu wetafile nawo.

faq.q: Ngaba kukhona ixesha elibalwayo okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo okanye ukoyisakala. Unokuyeka nanini na, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi yindlela entle kakhulu yokugqiba.
Hayi. Cofa iqhekeza elinye, uze ucofe elinye, aze atshintshisane ngeendawo. Oku kulula xa isandla singcangcazela okanye kwisikrini esincinci.
Ewe, usimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa okanye kukhuphela. Usebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha.

finish-the-saying.name: Gqibezela intetho
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Gqibezela Intetho: Umdlalo Wezaci Wabantu Abadala
finish-the-saying.description: Iintetho eziqhelekileyo zaseMelika ezingenalo igama lokugqibela, njengokuthi "A penny saved is a penny ___". Cofa ukhetho okanye ubonise isiphelo, uze uthethe ngayo.
finish-the-saying.short: Gqibezelani iintetho eziqhelekileyo kunye, nize nincokole ngazo.
finish-the-saying.intro: Iintetho ezindala zihlala zisaziwa ubomi bonke. Ikhadi ngalinye libonisa intetho eqhelekileyo engenalo igama lokugqibela, ukhetho oluthathu, kunye neqhosha elithi "Bonisa isiphelo". Emva kwesiphelo, umbuzo omhle umemelela incoko.
howTo: Fandani intetho leyo ngokuvakalayo kunye.
Cofa igama eliyigqibezelayo, okanye ucofe "Bonisa isiphelo".
Fandani yonke intetho kwakhona nize nincokole ngayo nisebenzisa umbuzo.
Cofa "Intetho elandelayo" xa sele nilungile.
tips: Funda ngokucotha uze unqumame kancinci ngaphambi kwegama lokugqibela. Amaxesha amaninzi abantu balibiza ngaphambi kokuba ugqibe.
Ukuba umntu unika isiphelo esahlukileyo, sonwabeleni eso siphelo. Ezinye iintetho ziyahluka ngokweentsapho okanye ngokwemimandla.
Kwiqela, umntu omnye uyafunda baze bonke abanye bangenelele kwisiphelo.

faq.q: Ngaba kukhona ixesha elibalwayo okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo okanye ukoyisakala. Unokuma nangawuphi na umzuzu, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi yindlela entle kakhulu yokugqiba.
Umdlalo ubonisa isiphelo esiqhelekileyo uze udlulele kwincoko. Awekho amanqaku, kwaye impendulo eyahlukileyo yamkelekile ngokupheleleyo.
Ewe, usimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa okanye kukhuphela. Usebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha.

word-search.name: Ukukhangela amagama anombhalo omkhulu
word-search.seoTitle: Ukukhangela Amagama Anombhalo Omkhulu Yabantu Abaphila neDementia, Ashicilelekayo
word-search.description: Umdlalo osimahla wokukhangela amagama anombhalo omkhulu owenzelwe abantu abadala kunye nabantu abaphila nedementia. Amagama ambalwa, oonobumba abakhulu, amagama ahamba ngokuthe tye nangezantsi kuphela. Dlala kwi-intanethi okanye uwashicilele.
word-search.short: Oonobumba abakhulu, amagama ambalwa, athe tye nasezantsi kuphela. Ungawashicilela nawo.
word-search.intro: Igridi encinci enoonobumba abakhulu namagama ambalwa nje, onke afundeka ngokuthe tye okanye ezantsi. Cofa unobumba wokuqala wegama, uze ucofe unobumba walo wokugqibela. Ingaba ukhetha iphepha? Shicilela iphazili entsha ngokucofa kanye nje.
howTo: Khetha umxholo nobukhulu begridi.
Jonga kuluhlu lwamagama. Amagama afundeka ngokuthe tye (ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene) okanye ezantsi (ukusuka phezulu ukuya ezantsi).
Cofa unobumba wokuqala wegama, uze ucofe unobumba walo wokugqibela.
Igama elifunyenweyo liyabalaseliswa lize licinywe kuluhlu.
Cofa u-"Shicilela le phazili" ukuze udlale ephepheni usebenzisa ipensile okanye imakha.
tips: Yalatha igama elikuluhlu nize nikhangele unobumba walo wokuqala nikunye.
Ephepheni, usiba olubalaselisayo kulula ukulubamba kunepensile.
Ncokolani ngamagama omxholo. Amagama eziqhamo ayindlela yendalo yokuvuselela iinkumbulo zokuvuna, ukubhaka okanye iimarike.

faq.q: Ingaba kukho ixesha elibalwayo okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo okanye ukoyisakala. Unokuma nangawuphi na umzuzu, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi yindlela entle kakhulu yokugqiba.
Ewe. Cofa u-"Shicilela le phazili" ukuze ushicilele igridi ekhoyo ngombhalo omkhulu, kunye noluhlu lwamagama ngaphantsi kwayo. Iphazili nganye entsha yahlukile.
Ewe, usimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa okanye kukhuphela. Usebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha.

coloring.name: Amaphepha okufaka imibala
coloring.seoTitle: Amaphepha Okufaka Imibala Yabantu Abadala Abaphila neDementia (Asimahla)
coloring.description: Amaphepha alula okufaka imibala abantu abadala anendawo ezinkulu: cofa umbala, uze ucofe umfanekiso. Akukho kungcolisa, akukho mibala iphosakeleyo, kwaye iphepha ngalinye linokushicilelwa simahla.
coloring.short: Cofa umbala, uze ucofe indawo yomfanekiso. Ungawashicilela namaphepha.
coloring.intro: Amaphepha anemilo emikhulu nelula: intyatyambo embizeni, indlu, ikomityi yeti, ibhabhathane nenqanawe ehamba ngomoya. Cofa umbala, uze ucofe indawo yomfanekiso ukuze uyizalise. Akukho mibala iphosakeleyo.
howTo: Khetha iphepha.
Cofa umbala. Umbala ngamnye unegama lawo elibhalwe kuwo.
Cofa indawo yomfanekiso ukuze uyizalise ngaloo mbala.
Tshintsha ingcinga yakho nanini na ngokuyizalisa kwakhona.
Cofa u-"Shicilela eli phepha" ukuze ufumane iphepha elingenanto lokufaka imibala ngeepensile okanye iimakha.
tips: Nika imibala emibini enokukhethwa kuyo endaweni yayo yonke ukuba ukukhetha kubonakala kuxakeke kakhulu.
Imithi emfusa nelanga eliluhlaza yamkelekile. Oku kumalunga nokonwabela umbala, hayi ukuchaneka.
Amaphepha ashicilelweyo asebenza kakuhle ngeemakha ezityebileyo okanye iikhrayoni, ekulula ukuzibamba.

faq.q: Ingaba kukho ixesha elibalwayo okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo okanye ukoyisakala. Unokuma nangawuphi na umzuzu, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi yindlela entle kakhulu yokugqiba.
Sizobe izinto ezizolileyo nezilula endaweni yopopayi, ukuze amaphepha afanele abantu abadala. Iimilo ezinkulu zenza ukufaka imibala kube lula ngaphandle kokwenza kube ngathi kokwabantwana abancinci.
Ewe, usimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa okanye kukhuphela. Usebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha.

conversation-cards.name: Amakhadi okuncokola
conversation-cards.description: Amakhadi anemifanekiso anezivuseleli zencoko ezimnene ezilungiselelwe abantu abaphila nedementia: akukho kubuza ngemibuzo, akukho mpendulo zilungileyo. Wasebenzise kwiskrini okanye ushicilele iseti epheleleyo.
conversation-cards.short: Amakhadi anemifanekiso anemibuzo evulelekileyo nenenekayo. Akukho mibuzo yovavanyo.
conversation-cards.intro: Ikhadi ngalinye lidibanisa umfanekiso oqhelekileyo nesimemo esivulelekileyo sokuncokola, esifana nesithi "Yeyiphi imozulu oyithanda kakhulu?" Akukho mpendulo zilungileyo kwaye akukho nto ekufuneka ikhunjulwe. Khetha umxholo okanye uwadibanise onke.
howTo: Khetha umxholo, okanye ugcine u-"Onke amakhadi".
Funda umbuzo ngokuvakalayo nize nijonge umfanekiso nikunye.
Mamela, wabelane ngempendulo yakho, uze uvumele incoko ihambe ngokukhululekileyo.
Cofa u-"Ikhadi elilandelayo" xa sele ulungile, okanye hlala kwikhadi elinye kangangoko uthanda.
Cofa u-"Shicilela onke amakhadi" ukuze usike iseti yephepha.
tips: Wuphendule nawe umbuzo ngokunjalo. Oku kwenza ivakale njengencoko, hayi udliwanondlebe.
Landela ibali, hayi iinyaniso. Ukuba iinkcukacha ziyatshintsha, kulungile oko.
Ukuba ikhadi lichukumisa into ebuhlungu, luqonde olo luvo uze ngobunono udlulele kwelinye ikhadi.

faq.a: Imibuzo evavanya inkumbulo inokuvakala njengoviwo ize ibangele iintloni. Izimemo ezivulelekileyo ezifana nokuthi "Ndibalisele nge…" zivumela nabani na ukuba athathe inxaxheba, nokuba yintoni na ayikhumbulayo.
Ewe. U-"Shicilela onke amakhadi" ushicilela iseti epheleleyo ngombhalo omkhulu, amakhadi aliqela kwiphepha ngalinye, elungele ukusikwa.
Ewe, isimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa okanye kukhuphela. Isebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, kwithebhulethi okanye kwikhompyutha.

photo-pairs.name: Izibini zeefoto
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Yenza umdlalo wokutshatisa usebenzisa iifoto zosapho
photo-pairs.description: Guqula iifoto zosapho lwakho zibe ngumdlalo olula wokutshatisa. Khetha iifoto ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-6 kwisixhobo sakho; zihlala kwisikhangeli sakho kwaye azize zilayishwe kwintanethi.
photo-pairs.short: Khetha ezakho iifoto uzitshatise. Akukho nto ilayishwa kwintanethi.
photo-pairs.intro: Khetha iifoto ezimbini ukuya kwezintandathu kwifowuni, kwithebhulethi okanye kwikhompyutha yakho, zize zijike zibe ngumdlalo wokutshatisa onemifanekiso emikhulu necacileyo. Iifoto ziboniswa kuphela kule phepha. Azilayishwa, azigcinwa okanye zabelwane nabanye, kwaye ziyanyamalala xa uvala eli phepha.
howTo: Cofa u-"Khetha iifoto" uze ukhethe iifoto ezimbini ukuya kwezintandathu.
Ifoto nganye ivela kabini. Cofa enye, uze ucofe isibini sayo.
Thethani ngefoto nganye njengoko niyifumana.
Xa ugqibile, vala iphepha okanye ucofe u-"Cima iifoto". Akukho nto igcinwayo.
tips: Khetha iifoto ezicacileyo zezinto ezizisa uvuyo neziqhelekileyo: isilwanyana sasekhaya, igadi, indawo ethandwayo, okanye usuku lomtshato.
Imifanekiso yeendawo neyezinto inokuba lula kuneendlela zobuso, kwaye iyaphepha naluphi na uxinzelelo lokukhumbula amagama abantu.
Kuphephe ukusebenzisa iifoto zabantu abangasekhoyo ukuba zisenokuzisa usizi olukhawulezileyo, ngaphandle kokuba uyazi ukuba zizisa intuthuzelo.

faq.q: Ingaba iifoto zam ziyalayishwa kwenye indawo?
faq.a: Hayi. Eli phepha lifunda iifoto ozikhethileyo ngokuthe ngqo kwisikhangeli sakho lize lizibonise kwikhusi lakho. Azithunyelwa kuthi okanye nakubani na omnye, kwaye ziyaphela xa uvala okanye uhlaziya iphepha.

faq.q: Ingaba ikhona iwotshi yexesha okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo okanye ukoyisakala. Ungema nanini na, kwaye nokuyeka phakathi yindlela entle yokugqiba.
Hayi kwisikhangeli, kwenzelwe ukuba kungabikho nto yabucala egcinwayo. I-app yasimahla ye-Golden Moments ye-iPhone ne-iPad inokugcina iikopi zeefoto ezikhethiweyo kwisixhobo sakho.

picture-bingo.name: Ibhingo yemifanekiso
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Ibhingo yemifanekiso yabantu abadala abaphila nesifo sokulibala: Eprintwayo
picture-bingo.description: Ibhingo yemifanekiso eprintwayo yasimahla yeenkqubo zokunyamekela inkumbulo namaqela abantu abadala, enommemi omkhulu osekhusini. Imifanekiso emikhulu enamagama, izikwere ezi-9 okanye ezi-16, akufuneki kukwazi ukufunda.
picture-bingo.short: Amakhadi eprintwayo ebhingo yemifanekiso nommemi osekhusini elikhulu wamaqela.
picture-bingo.intro: Ibhingo eqhelekileyo enemifanekiso endaweni yamanani, ukuze kungabikho mntu kufuneka afunde amagama amancinci. Printa amakhadi awahlukeneyo, uze usebenzise ummemi osekhusini ukubonisa umfanekiso ngamnye emkhulu kwi-TV, kwilaptop okanye kwithebhulethi.
howTo: Khetha izikwere ezi-9 okanye ezi-16 kwikhadi ngalinye nenani labadlali.
Cofa u-"Printa amakhadi". Ikhadi ngalinye lahlukile.
Vula ummemi kwikhusi elikhulu. Cofa u-"Umfanekiso olandelayo" ukubonisa umfanekiso ngamnye kunye negama lawo.
Abadlali bagquma umfanekiso otshatayo kwikhadi labo ngengqekembe, iqhosha okanye uphawu.
Wonke umntu ogcwalisa umqolo, okanye ikhadi lonke, uyaqhwatyelwa izandla. Akukho boyisakeleyo kolu hlobo lomdlalo: qhubekani nidlala de wonke umntu abe nomqolo.
tips: Sebenzisani izinto ezinkulu ezifana neekepusi zeebhotile okanye amatye amakhulu okudlala. Amaqhosha amancinci anokuba nzima ukuwachola.
Xela igama lomfanekiso uze uthethe okuthile ngawo: "Isikhephe. Ngubani owakha wakhwela esikhepheni?"
Hlalisa abantu abanengxaki yokubona kufuphi nekhusi, uze udibanise abancedisi nabadlali abafuna uncedo.
Izikwere ezilithoba zanele uninzi lwamaqela. Gcinani ixesha lomdlalo libe malunga nemizuzu engama-20 ukuya kwengama-30.

faq.q: Ndiwubaleka njani umdlalo webhingo yemifanekiso kwikhaya lokunyamekela?
faq.a: Printa ikhadi elinye kumdlali ngamnye, beka ummemi kwelona khusi likhulu unalo, uze ubize imifanekiso kancinci, uxela igama lalowo nalowo. Dlalani de wonke umntu abe nomqolo, ukuze kungabikho mntu usalayo ngasemva.
Ewe. Printa amakhadi amaninzi ngendlela owadinga ngayo, kangangoko uthanda, ukuba asetyenziswe nguwe okanye liqela.
Ewe. Isikwere ngasinye sinomfanekiso omkhulu, onegama lawo ngaphantsi kwabo bathanda amagama.

calm-breathing.name: Ukuphefumla ngokuzolileyo
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Ikhefu lokuphefumla ngokuzolileyo labantu abadala nabanonopheli
calm-breathing.description: Ikhefu lokuphefumla elicothayo nelizolileyo lokwabelana: isangqa esilula siyakhula size sinciphe kwizihlandlo ezithandathu zokuphefumla. Uyasisiqala, kwaye ungasimisa nanini na.
calm-breathing.short: Isangqa esicothayo sokuphefumla naso. Qala uze umise xa uthanda.
calm-breathing.intro: Maxa wambi owona msebenzi mhle likhefu elizolileyo. Cofa u-"Qala", uze utsal' umoya ngaphakathi njengoko isangqa sikhula uze uwukuphe njengoko sincipha. Khetha isantya esicothayo okanye esikhawulezayo. Oku ayilonyango, ngumzuzu nje woxolo nowokwabelana.
howTo: Hlalani kamnandi ecaleni komnye nomnye.
Khetha isantya: esicothayo okanye esizolileyo.
Cofa u-"Qala". Tsal' umoya ngaphakathi ngelixa isangqa sikhula, uze uwukuphe ngelixa sincipha.
Siyazimisela ngokwaso emva kokuphefumla kathandathu, okanye ucofe u-"Misa" nanini na uthanda.
tips: Bambanani ngezandla okanye ubeke isandla engalweni yomntu ukuba oko kwamkelekile kuye.
Ungaze unyanzelise. Ukuba babethanda ukubukela nje, kulungile oko.
Ukuba umntu unengxaki yokuphefumla, makaphefumle ngendlela eqhelekileyo aze abukele nje isangqa. Buza ugqirha ngayo nayiphi na inkxalabo yokuphefumla.

faq.a: Hayi. Lixesha nje elilula nelikhethekayo lokuzola nokuba kunye. Asilonyango lwenkxalabo okanye lwayo nayiphi na imeko yempilo. Thetha nogqirha malunga neenkxalabo zempilo.

faq.q: Ingaba isangqa siyashukuma ngaphandle kokuba ndisiqale?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho nto ishukumayo ude ucofe u-Start, kwaye iyayeka emva kokuphefumla izihlandlo ezi-6 okanye xa ucofe u-Stop. Ukuba isixhobo sakho simiselwe ukunciphisa ukushukuma, amagama ayatshintsha ngaphandle kokuba isangqa sikhule.
Ewe, kusimahla, kwaye akukho akhawunti, ukubhalisa okanye ukukhuphela. Isebenza kwibhrawuza yewebhu kwifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha.
